 A Beginner's Crash Course in APA Style [RESCHEDULED]
 Online
 The APA citation style is often used in social science related research. Not sure where to start? 
 Join this workshop to learn the basics of APA citation style, including how to create in-text citations and reference lists, avoid plagiarism, acknowledge other researchers, and correctly reference common types of sources in your research.
 Whether you're just starting your research journey or looking to strengthen your academic skills, understanding how to cite and reference your sources is an important part of the research process. This workshop will help you become familiar with APA style and build a strong foundation for citing sources accurately and confidently in your research.
 This class will be held on Zoom and the link will be sent the 3 hours before the workshop. This workshop will NOT be recorded.
